    Wild Flowers Pretzel Bites

    posted by Laurie on May 6, 2026 // 0 Comments
    • Facebook
    • Twitter
    Jump to Recipe
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 5:29
    Instaread

    Make any day special with easy Wild Flower Flower Pretzel Bites! Festive, colorful, and perfect for brunches or gatherings. Sweet-and-salty crowd favorite!

    Wild Flower Pretzel Bites are a fun snack for a spring brunch, a Mother’s Day celebration, or a casual get-together with friends. We’ve combined pretzels, white chocolate and M&M’s into a crowd-pleasing flower shaped treat that is the perfect bite-sized combination of sweet and salty. Made with Green, Lavender, and White M&M’s, they’re as beautiful as they are delicious, with soft pastel colors that celebrate spring. A great make-ahead snack, you’ll only need three ingredients to make these super yummy treats for your next springtime party. And guess what? They double as a dessert AND a pretty decoration and that’s a Two Sister’s win/win. Whether you’re hosting a brunch for the moms in your life or simply need a cute and tasty party finger food, these Pretzel Bites are bound to become a go-to snack that you find yourself making again and again.

    Ingredients You Will Need

    Preparing the M&M’s

    We used the special Springtime/Easter Blend bag of M&M’s that have Lavender and Lt. Green M&M’s as part of the mix. This particular version of the special Holiday M&M’s are usually available in stores in the spring, after Valentines and before Easter.  You can also find them year-round on Amazon. You can also buy individual bags of white, lavender and light green M&M’s at party stores, online on Amazon and from the official M&M website.

    How to Make the Pretzel Bites

    Steps 1-2: For the pretzels, we like to use the square “snaps” or the round “waffle” pretzels because we think they hold the melted chocolate with less dripping but you can make Mini Pretzels work too if that is all you can find at the grocery store.  First, place 7-8 Pretzel Snaps on a paper plate. Cover the pretzels with a White Chocolate Melting Wafer. Place the paper plate in the microwave and heat for approximately 45-50 seconds. The exact timing will take a bit of trial and error.  You want the candy melts to be melted enough to press the M&M’s into, but not so melted that the candy melt loses its’ shape.  In the picture above you can see that the white candy melts have a sheen to them – this is what they look like when they are the melted the perfect amount.  The exact time in the microwave will depend on how many pretzel/candy you do at one time, how powerful your microwave is, the type of pretzels you are using, etc.  For us, 7-8 pretzels snaps take 50 seconds to melt to the right consistency.

    Steps 3-10: Start by pressing a white M&M into the center of the melted candy melt.  Now create the flower petals with lavender and light green M&M’s – we used six M&M’s for the petals.  

    We created two different color versions of the Wild Flower Pretzel Bites – Lavender with a White center and Light Green with a White center. Let them cool for a couple of hours so that the White Chocolate fully sets up and the M&M’s are firmly attached to the pretzels.

    Storage Instructions

    You can store Pretzel Bites in an air-tight container for a very long time so this is a great make-ahead party food.  Your goal is simply to keep the Pretzels from getting stale, the chocolate and M&M’s will be fine for a long time.  We have kept them in a container in the pantry for weeks and they still taste great.  You can freeze them but we don’t recommend it. Sometimes, during the defrosting process, the M&M’s lose their shiny coat.

    Wild Flower Pretzel Bites

    Prep Time 10 minutes
    Additional Time 10 minutes
    Total Time 20 minutes

    Make any day special with these easy Wild Flower Flower Pretzel Bites! Festive, colorful, and perfect for brunches or gatherings. Sweet-and-salty crowd favorite!

    Ingredients

    • 1 bag Rold Gold Waffle Pretzels or Hanover Pretzel Snaps
    • 1 bag Ghirardelli White Chocolate Melting Wafers
    • 2 bags Pastel Colored M&M’s - Lavender, Light Green & White

    Instructions

        1. Arrange 8 to 9 Pretzel Snaps on a paper plate.
        2. Place a candy melt in the center of each pretzel.
        3. Place the plate of pretzels in the microwave and heat them until the candy melts are at the beginning stage of being melted. They should be soft to the touch and melted enough to press a M&M down into it but not so melty that the candy is running off the pretzel. (Approximately 50 seconds.)
        4. Using a White colored M&M's, place it in the center of the melted candy melt for the flower center.
        5. Now press in the flower petals with contrasting colored M&M's - we used six M&M's for the petals in Lavender and Lt. Green.
        6. Let the white chocolate on the Flower Pretzel Bites fully cool and harden back up before you move them.
        7. Store in an air-tight container.

    Notes

    Where to Find the Lavender, Light Green and White M&M's
    We used the special Springtime/Easter Blend bag of M&M’s that Lavender and Lt. Green M&M’s. This particular version of the Holiday M&M’s usually start being available in the spring around Easter.  You can buy individual bags of white, lavender and light green M&M’s at party stores, online on Amazon and from the M&M website.
